summary: First QA pass for Aptimizer. Backend: 32/32 pytest tests pass (auth incl. admin seed/register/login/duplicate/bad-password/me, RBAC admin GET /api/users, engineer/viewer 403, viewer create-project 403, viewer PUT 403, project CRUD, add-tower, /analysis with seeded expectations plot_area=3994.59 m2 / 48 units / FAR 1.61 / compliance 12/12, live /analyse, versions save+restore, shares to registered viewer + activity log, share to unregistered email returns 404, 7 PDF reports + BOQ xlsx all download >500 bytes). Frontend: verified admin login, project create -> workspace, MetricsStrip live values, module navigation across all 11 modules, add-tower live update (FAR 1.61 -> 3.22 after tower B added), executive PDF + BOQ xlsx downloads via UI (6667/8319 bytes), compliance rule threshold edit (FAR-01 threshold 3.0->0.1 flips to FAIL and appears in Violations panel, score dropped to 8/12), autosave SAVED indicator visible, viewer read-only flow (badge='viewer', 14/16 plot inputs disabled). No blocking issues found.

issues: React a11y warning: Missing Description or aria-describedby on {DialogContent} (non-blocking, appears twice in console)

action_items: (Optional) Add DialogDescription or aria-describedby to Dialog components in Projects page to silence a11y warning.
(Optional) On Plot module for viewers, the two 'Plot Reference' style inputs at the top appear editable while other 14 are correctly disabled - verify these should also be read-only for viewers.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py load_project mirrors owner_id as string for shares but compares str(owner_id) - fine. Consider unifying to always store owner_id as string (already does) - good.
server.py: HTTPException in oid() returns 404 for bad ObjectId; acceptable and consistent.
engine.parking_metrics returns keys 'required_slots'/'provided_slots' (not 'required'/'provided') - documentation/testing should reflect this; my tests updated to match code.
Login attempt lockout after 5 failed attempts for 15 min is implemented (server.py L114-125). Good.
seed_admin logic updates admin password if changed (L475-477). Good.
auth.set_auth_cookies uses httpOnly cookies + Bearer token in localStorage - dual auth supported.
CORS uses FRONTEND_URL from env with allow_credentials=True and explicit origins (not wildcard when credentials enabled) - correct.
